action.objective: Verify the reserved candidate d4d5 at full depth, checking for tactical refutations and king safety before committing.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 3 left d4d5 (score 1955, exact) as the top move, but only at completed depth 3 and no single-candidate verification yet. The verification reserve of 2000 nodes is specifically held for d4d5. d4d5 attacks the c6 queen and pushes the center pawn while Black's rook on g3 eyes our kingside; I need to confirm no Black tactical refutation (e.g. Qxf2+/mate threats) exists before committing. Using the reserved allowance.
